svg.title: DocQuery architecture
svg.desc: Three zones: browser, local backend, and external services. The backend ingests OpenAPI specs into per-spec indexes, optionally transcribes voice through Groq Whisper, and answers queries through a compiled LangGraph StateGraph. Its nodes contextualize, route, decompose, retrieve, generate, score confidence, and conditionally finalize or make one bounded retry. Langfuse receives traces from the backend.
